# Jan Henrik Gundelsby

> Head of Knowit Research at Knowit (Oslo) and part-time Lecturer (Universitetslektor) in Software Engineering at the Department of Informatics, University of Oslo. Researches how organizations adopt AI agents in software development: human-AI collaboration, agentic software engineering, technical and cognitive debt, and large-scale agile. Leads the KAIROS research project on human-AI collaboration with SINTEF and industry partners. ORCID 0000-0001-5275-6553.
